faqs.question: How can I submit an abstract for the conference?
faqs.answer: You can submit your abstract by emailing contact@nextconferences.org using the template available on the conference website. All abstracts are reviewed by the scientific committee, and you will receive a notification regarding acceptance within 24–48 hours of submission.

faqs.question: How can I register for the conference?
faqs.answer: You can register for the conference online or offline. For online registration, please visit the conference registration page on our website. For offline registration, email contact@nextconferences.org. NEXT Conferences accepts international cards through secure payment gateways such as Stripe and PayPal. You can also pay the registration fee through a bank transfer using the account details provided in the official invoice.

faqs.question: What benefits will I receive after registration?
faqs.answer: Please refer to the Speaker Benefits section on our website for details about the benefits included with your registration.

faqs.question: Where can I find my presentation slot?
faqs.answer: The final scientific program will be published on the conference webpage approximately one month before the conference, or as early as possible. If you need to confirm your presentation slot earlier, please email contact@nextconferences.org.

faqs.question: Can I reserve a specific presentation slot?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can request a specific presentation slot, provided it is available when your request is received. Please contact contact@nextconferences.org to confirm availability.

faqs.question: Are speaker registrations limited?
faqs.answer: Yes, speaker slots are limited. We recommend completing your registration as early as possible to secure your participation and help finalize the scientific program.

faqs.question: How can I book hotel accommodation during the conference?
faqs.answer: You can book accommodation through the Deal-A and Deal-B registration options on the conference webpage. Deal-A includes two nights of accommodation, while Deal-B includes three nights. For additional accommodation, please email contact@nextconferences.org.

faqs.question: Can I attend the conference with an accompanying person?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can bring an accompanying person by selecting the applicable add-on option available on the conference registration page.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my conference registration?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can request cancellation in accordance with the refund policy published on the conference website. Please review the policy for the applicable terms and conditions.

faqs.question: Are discounts available on registration fees?
faqs.answer: Yes, a group discount of 25% per registration is available for groups of at least four participants.

faqs.question: Can I bring my presentation on my own USB drive?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can bring your presentation on your own USB drive. Alternatively, you can email your presentation to the conference coordinator one day before the conference.
